newsitem.title: USA: RightChoice names O'Rourke as president.
newsitem.headline: RightChoice names O'Rourke as president.

text.p: RightChoice Managed Care Inc said Wednesday its board named John O'Rourke to the additional position of president.

He became chairman and chief executive officer of RightChoice on February 18. O'Rourke replaces Frederic Brussee, whose employment was terminated. A company spokeswoman declined to provide further details.
The company said O'Rourke would have full operational and strategic management responsibilities for RightChoice.

Norman Tice, continuing as vice chairman, will focus on the development of mergers, acquisitions and strategic alliances, including ongoing discussions regarding a potential alliance with BJC Health Systems.

O'Rourke also will assume the additional title of president and chief executive officer of the parent company, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri, replacing Roy Heimburger, whose employment was terminated. He was named Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri chief operating officer on February 18.
RightChoice Managed Care, the publicly held subsidiary of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri, is the largest provider of managed care services in Missouri, covering about 1.9 million members.
